issues.path: detail[Sch G School Nutrition Fund, '1620 Non Reimbursable'].category
issues.issue: These are sales of non-reimbursable meals, not a reimbursement. The statement's Sales of Meals 53,236.67 (p9) = 40,580.63 + 512.39 + 12,143.65, and the line's own detail_category is school lunch sales, so the category should be School Lunch Sales.

issues.path: detail[Sch M, departments 3512 Distance Education, 3535 High Ability Learners, 3551 Career Education (5 lines)].category
issues.on_page: Statement line State Programs 13,952.45 (p13) = 5,696.70 + 755.75 + 7,500.00 (Sch B p20)
issues.issue: The report counts these program lines in its State Programs line, so they belong in State Categorical Programs (user rule 2026-10-28), not instruction.

issues.path: detail[Sch M, departments 6200 Title I, 6406 IDEA Preschool, 6408 IDEA Part B, 6992 Reap (9 lines)].category
issues.issue: The report groups these program lines under its Federal Programs line, so their category should be Federal Programs, not instruction (user rule 2026-10-28).

issues.on_page: Printed transfers out 265,054.09 (p13); Sch M 2650 Property 100,000.00 and 2710 Property 200,000.00 (p36) are printed as spending
issues.issue: The 300,000 reclassification from spending to transfer out (statement lines 'Vehicle Operation, Maintenance, & Purchasing' and 'Vehicle Operation & Purchasing - Regular Education', and the Sch M contra lines) is inferred only because 100,000 + 200,000 matches the Depreciation Fund's 300,000 'Allocation from General Fund'. No elimination column or note in the report confirms it, and the budgets don't match (allocation budget 200,000 vs property budgets 30,000 + 100,000). The amounts are marked computed/split_from and the totals tie, but this is an assumption.

issues.on_page: Depreciation Fund 5200 Allocation from General Fund 300,000.00 (p21); General Fund shows only 265,000 of transfers out (p38)
issues.issue: This is a one-sided transfer that the extractor settled by assumption: it moved 300,000 of General Fund Property spending to transfers. A person should confirm it, but decision_needed has no entry for it.
The Statement of Activities (p13) shows this amount as Charges for Services on the transportation line. It is a fee paid by other districts, so charges for services/fees is arguable.

issues.on_page: GF 5300 Proceeds From Disposal of Property 42.00 + 5690 2,298.77; Depreciation 5690 6,272.30
issues.issue: The residual Non-Revenue Receipts line includes 42.00 of sale of property, which is not split out to Sale of Property. The amount is immaterial.
Judgement mapping of the 800-series 'Other Items' object. It could also be miscellaneous expenditure.
